### Analytics {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/analytics}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then open a campaign; Analytics is its default view.
- "Leads Contacted": unique people who got at least one email, capped at leads uploaded.
- "Replies": reply rate vs leads contacted. "Include auto replies" is on by default (counts out-of-office); off counts manual replies only.
- "Positive Replies": AI-classified genuine interest, with a target (Healthy PRR from the "Options" tab; podcast default 1%). Out-of-office, not interested and unsubscribes don't count.
- "Booked Calls": % of positive replies; target default 25%, set on "Options".
- Trend chart: "Contacted" is emails sent per day including follow-ups (not unique leads), plus "Replied" and "Positive". Ranges: Last 7 days to All time.
- Per-step tables: "Total" row plus one row per variant, with an enable/disable toggle. Columns: "Sent", "Replied", "Positive Responses", "Booked Calls". All per-email, not per-lead. Disabling stops future use; history stays. The agent acts only after a variant passes the "Minimum Threshold" of sends.
- Zero replies after 1,000+ sends: likely deliverability. Check bounce rate on the "Leads" tab (auto-pauses at 5%), inbox health in Email Accounts (below 80% is a problem), and send yourself a test.
- No activity for 3+ days: check campaign status, sending schedule on "Options", inbox health, Attention Needed banners.

### AI Agent {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/ai-agent}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", open a campaign, then click the "AI Agent" tab.
- Reviews active campaigns about once a day; waits if data is thin or in cooldown. Timeline cards: "Key Finding", "Recommended Actions", "Pending Actions", "Actions Successfully Taken".
- Turn on: "Settings" > "Cold Email Agent" (future campaign defaults) or the campaign's "Options" tab, "Cold Email Agent" section. Master switch "AI campaign management"; off means insights only.
- Modes per action: "Run automatically", "Ask first", "Off". Recommended: "Optimize email variants" on Run automatically; "Add more leads" (can spend lead credits), "Start new campaigns", "Pause underperforming campaigns" (only alongside a replacement campaign) on Ask first. Keep "Run actions when approvals expire" off.
- "How quickly should the agent act?": "Careful", "Balanced" (recommended), "Proactive", "Custom".
- Approvals expire after 24 hours. Buttons: "Approve", "Reject", "Review later", "Continue" (needs lead-source filters or CSV), "Top up". Approval that would disable every variant is blocked. CSVs use no credits but count toward contact capacity.
- Re-enable variants on the "Sequences" tab.
- Recommendation but no action: switch off, mode Ask first or Off, or waiting for data or lead source.

### Inbox warmup {slug: cold-email-agent/email-accounts/warmup}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then "Email Accounts"
- Warmup runs automatically on every inbox.
- Orange flame = initial warmup (new DFY inboxes, about 2 weeks, no campaigns). Green flame = continuous warmup (ongoing, can send).
- Pre-warmed inboxes have 4+ weeks done and are green on day one.
- Health score: 90%+ good. 80-90% warning: keep warmup, add no new volume. Below 80%: pause from campaigns, replacing is usually safer. A dash means not enough data. It reflects warmup traffic only.
- Ready when "Status" is Active, flame is green, and score is 90%+ (or a dash with green flame).
- Score dropped: causes are a bounce rate over 5%, too-fast ramp (platform max 35 campaign emails per inbox per day), spammy copy. Pause the inbox from campaigns, keep warmup on, recheck in 5-7 days.
- Orange after 2 weeks: Error, use "Reconnect"; Paused, re-enable; Warmup, wait 3-5 more days; over 3 weeks, contact support with the inbox address.
- 0 emails: still provisioning (wait 24 hours), Paused, or Error.
- Good score but no replies: check bounce rate in Analytics, copy, angle.

- Select rows for "Bulk actions" > "Enable Accounts"; "Move Accounts" opens a destination workspace dropdown.
- Domain cancel: "Settings" > "Billing" > "Email Accounts & Domains".
- Burnt inbox: remove from campaigns, find the cause, buy a replacement (pre-warmed is fastest, DFY needs 2 weeks), swap it in the campaign's "Options" tab.

## Who can do what

- Only the Owner and Admin roles can see or edit Workspace Settings, while Member roles can only view them, and Client roles cannot see them at all {workspace-settings}.
- Only the Owner role can access and manage Workspace Billing settings {workspace-settings} {workspace-settings/billing}.
- Only Owner and Admin roles can invite new team members or revoke pending invitations {workspace-settings/members}.
- Only the Owner role can transfer workspace ownership or demote another Owner {workspace-settings/members} {workspace-settings/faq/members-roles/how-do-i-change-my-workspace-role-from-membereditor-to-owner}.
- Admins cannot change an Owner's role or create new Owners {workspace-settings/members} {workspace-settings/faq/members-roles/how-do-i-change-my-workspace-role-from-membereditor-to-owner}.
- Only Owner and Admin roles can delete campaigns {cold-email-agent/faq/campaigns/how-do-i-find-the-campaign-delete-menu}.
- Only Owner and Admin roles can rename workspaces {workspace-settings/faq/workspace-management/how-do-i-rename-a-workspace}.
- Only Owner, Admin, and Member roles can access the Sales Call Analyzer, while the Client role is completely blocked from accessing it {sales-call-analyzer/faq/can-my-team-members-access-sales-call-analyzer}.
- The Client role can only access the AI SDR if the white-label partner has specifically enabled it {ai-sdr}.
- Client roles are completely hidden from accessing the "Resources" menu {resources}.
- Only the Owner role can view combined credit balances and purchase one-time or recurring credits {workspace-settings/faq/billing-subscriptions/when-do-my-credits-reset}.
- The Client role cannot see or access the "Feedback" option in the sidebar to contact support {support}.
